name: Dave Brat
desc: American economist and professor at Randolph–Macon College
summary: David Alan Brat (born July 27, 1964) is an American politician, diplomat, academic, and economist who served as the U.S. representative for Virginia's 7th congressional district from 2014 to 2019. A member of the Republican Party, he was first elected in 2014 after successfully primarying House majority leader Eric Cantor despite being significantly outspent. Brat served two terms before he narrowly lost re-election in 2018 to Democrat Abigail Spanberger.
